summary: Quote and LTP on one equity: HSM's binary login waits for its K, the symbol-feed snapshot gives both frames, and an update record carrying only the changed fields is applied whole to the snapshot.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full); the web's Fyers adapter sends no mode key (its subscription_mode is the number).
The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.

Every desktop frame carries the trade time as ltt in epoch ms (the recorded transcripts' key); the web's Fyers adapter names it last_trade_time (seconds), which the desktop sends beside it (feed::dialect).
The web's Fyers frames carry the broker's exchange token; the desktop's frames do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.
The web's Fyers frames carry the mapper's data_type label; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web's Fyers frames say whether the message was a snapshot or a live update; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web's Fyers frames carry the subscription's mode number; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web's Fyers quote carries HSM's best bid and ask with their sizes; the desktop's common carrier drops them (audit P-11, lane wire bid/ask fields).
